subject: Finalizing MAP: milestone-linked TPM & pricing cadence
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily@nimbusretail.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: David Park <david@retailops.io>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + initial TPM targets for evaluation

Team — thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is the MAP sketch we referenced (high level). We want to run a tight 3-month evaluation and then move to a committed ramp that lines up with our holiday push. Key asks from our side:

- Evaluation phase (Month 0–2): 20M tokens/month (pilot traffic), success criteria: 95th pctl latency < 400ms, NPS from merchant testers >= 4.0, <1% failure rate.
- Ramp / Commit proposal: Month 3: 75M TPM; Month 4: 200M TPM; Month 5+: 400M TPM sustained.
- Pricing: prefer a stepped discount tied to hitting MAP milestones (e.g., 10% after Month 4 sustained volume, 20% after Month 6 sustained).
- Procurement: shorter SOW preferred; legal will need a standard security addendum.

Can you confirm Redwood can support the Month 3->4->5 ramp cadence and provide a milestone-linked pricing table? Also need clarity on overage handling (do we bill overage monthly at list or pro-rate into committed band?).

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Chen
Head of Consumer Product, Nimbus Retail
[Attachment: Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)]

---
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, David Park <david@retailops.io>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + initial TPM targets for evaluation

Emily — appreciate the clear objectives. We can support the ramp cadence you outlined but want to propose a MAP that ties discounts and committed units to measurable milestones so both sides are protected. High-level response: 

- Evaluation months (0–2): we’ll provide a capped trial of 25M tokens/month at reduced eval pricing (no commitment) so you can run QA and merchant tests.
- Commit banding: propose a three-tier commit ladder that maps to your Month 3–5 targets:
  * Tier A (commit onset): 75M TPM guaranteed (Month 3) — onboarding fee waived if signed by 7/20.
  * Tier B (growth): 200M TPM guaranteed (Month 4) — 10% unit discount applied starting month 5 if Tier B sustained for 30 days.
  * Tier C (sustained): 400M TPM (Month 5+) — additional 10% discount (20% total) after 60 continuous days at or above Tier C.
- Overage: default is billed at list when exceeding committed TPM in a month. We can offer a blended true-up option where overage during a ramp month is credited against future committed months if you hit planned milestones within the following 60 days.

I’ll loop in Ben for line-item pricing and LA for contractual language. If this looks reasonable I’ll put together a short SOW + MAP spreadsheet and a DocuSign to close by July 15 to keep onboarding on track.

- Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@nimbusretail.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: David Park <david@retailops.io>
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + initial TPM targets for evaluation

Emily, team — attaching the numeric MAP and a draft SOW for your review. Highlights from pricing grid (see Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx):

- Eval pricing: $0.0035 per 1k tokens, capped at 25M tokens/month for months 0–2.
- Committed bands (monthly effective unit price per 1k tokens):
  * 75M TPM band: $0.0028 / 1k
  * 200M TPM band: $0.0022 / 1k (10% discount applied on top of 75M price once sustained)
  * 400M TPM band: $0.00176 / 1k (20% total discount once sustained)
- Ramp credits: one-time onboarding credit of $30k if contract signed by 7/15.
- Overage policy: overage billed at list ($0.0032 / 1k) but will be credited as a usage credit if the committed band is achieved within the following 60 days (applies only during first 3 months after signature).

Operational notes: dedicated pool can be pre-warmed ahead of Month 4 to help meet latency goals; we’ll want a 2-week capacity provisioning window. Security addendum (SOC2 + data residency notes) attached to the SOW.

Attachment: Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx (pricing and month-by-month TPM table)
Attachment: SOW-draft.pdf

Ben Carter
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference

---
From: Emily Chen <emily@nimbusretail.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: David Park <david@retailops.io>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + initial TPM targets for evaluation

Thanks — looks good overall. A few items from procurement/legal and product: 

1) Can we get the onboarding credit written as a contingent credit (i.e., applied after successful onramp performance) rather than up-front?
2) Overage credit window: prefer 90 days rather than 60 for extra runway during holiday season.
3) Payment terms: Net 45 is acceptable but request a 30-day review period for usage reconciliation.
4) SOW: can you add explicit rollback/fallback policy in case latency targets are missed for two consecutive weeks? That’s a big concern for our merchants.

I'll also ask our infra lead (David) to confirm estimated traffic shape so we can align provisioning windows.

Emily

---
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@nimbusretail.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + initial TPM targets for evaluation

Emily/Priyom/Ben — quick internal approval note from finance/ops: 

- We can accept contingent onboarding credit (applied after successful onramp performance) up to $30k.
- We are willing to extend the overage credit window to 90 days during the first 90 days post-signature (one-time concession).
- Net 45 remains our standard; we can include a 30-day dispute window for usage reconciliation but prefer to keep payment at Net 45.
- Fallback SLA language: we will add a two-week remediation plan clause with an automatic temporary capacity re-route to a lower-cost model variant (no customer-facing downtime) if latency thresholds are missed for >2 weeks; full engineering runbook to be attached to the SOW.

If Nimbus signs by 7/15 we'll also include a one-month free pre-warm that will allow us to provision capacity the week prior to Month 4.

-Lauren
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

---
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@nimbusretail.com>, David Park <david@retailops.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + initial TPM targets for evaluation

Emily & David — thanks for the quick turn. Summarizing agreed points so we can close the MAP and get SOW executed: 

Agreed commercial points
- Eval: 25M tokens/month (months 0–2) at $0.0035/1k; no commitment.
- Commit ladder: 75M (Month 3), 200M (Month 4), 400M (Month 5+).
- Pricing: tiered pricing as shared; 10% discount after sustaining 200M for 30 days; 20% total after 60 continuous days at 400M.
- Onboarding credit: $30k contingent (applied after successful onramp), one-month free pre-warm if signed by 7/15.
- Overage: billed at list, credited if committed band achieved within 90 days post-signature.
- Payment: Net 45; usage dispute window 30 days.
- SLA / fallback: remediation runbook + temporary model variant routing if latency targets missed >2 consecutive weeks.

Next steps
1) Ben & I will upload the final MAP spreadsheet and SOW to Drive and push a DocuSign envelope. (HubSpot deal updated: https://hubspot.company/deals/RF-2026-084)
2) Emily — can you confirm David’s estimated traffic shape by Monday 7/13 so we can schedule the pre-warm?
3) If Nimbus is good to sign by 7/15 we’ll lock in the onboarding credit and pre-warm window.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/link/NRM-2026-084
Drive folder: https://drive.company.com/drive/folders/nimbus-map

Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf (updated with fallback clause)

Thanks,
